rules: Missing or undecodable exact logos route to an HSD-owned team badge instead of crashing or dropping the event.
A missing verified player image routes to a non-player TEAM SPOTLIGHT layout instead of a fake athlete image.
Render-safe and live-ready are separate states.
HSD fallback badges may enter human review but never bypass exact-hash visual approval.
Fixture images, invented faces, fake jerseys, and fabricated player identities remain prohibited.
Production cutover and auto-publish remain disabled.
